## Purpose

Explain the issue solved, expected behavior, and why this change is appropriate.

## Verification

- [ ] I ran `npm test` locally.
- [ ] I added/updated regression tests if behavior changed.
- [ ] I used only synthetic data (no personal records, secrets, real evidence or production logs).
- [ ] I reviewed the threat model and any authorization implications.
- [ ] I documented breaking changes or dependency additions.

## Security

Do not disclose vulnerabilities here; use private vulnerability reporting or an established private channel.
